Senses.Explanation: To sit cutting off the ten directions means occupying the field so completely that no directional route remains. At a memorial address, Hongzhi Zhengjue asks who sits cutting off all directions. the questioner claims the phrase after Yuanwu raises the sword; Yuanwu answers “seven vertical, eight horizontal.” Wuyi says realization here not only cuts off ten directions but makes the buddhas bow.
